prompt.alinti: Claude can now read your scripts out loud in a voice you picked yourself.
The Fish Audio MCP server is hosted, so there is no API key to paste.
One line in Claude Code, a browser sign-in, and Claude can search voices, generate speech, and transcribe recordings without leaving the thread.
Slide 5 has the audio tag syntax that fixes a flat read.
Follow @claudetipsandtricks for one Claude tip every day.
Transcribe meeting.mp3 and pull out every decision we made.
Find a calm English narration voice and read intro.md aloud. Give me the audio link.
How many Fish Audio credits do I have left?

yontem.ne: Fish Audio tarafından sunulan MCP sunucusuyla ses üretilmesi ve metin okunması için bir entegrasyon yöntemi.
yontem.alinti: Fish Audio ships an MCP server. Connecting it takes one line.

yontem.ne: Metinde kullanılan [whispering], [excited] gibi etiketlerle ses tonunu ayarlama.
yontem.alinti: Put a tag in square brackets inside the text. Fish Audio performs it instead of reading it out, which is how you fix a flat read.

yontem.ne: Kayıtlı ses dosyalarını metne çevirme ve işleme.
yontem.alinti: Point Claude at a recording and it uploads the file, transcribes it, then keeps working with the text in the same thread.

yontem.ne: Kullanıcı tarafından seçilen ses tonu ve karakteristik sesler.
yontem.alinti: Ask for the voice you want. Claude picks the tools itself. It searches the voice library, generates the read, and hands back a permanent link to the audio.

akis.ne: Fish Audio MCP sunucusunu Claude'a bağlama (bir komutla yapılır).
akis.alinti: Run this in Claude Code, then sign in through the browser window it opens.

akis.alinti: On Claude.ai open Settings, then Connectors, then Add custom connector. Paste the endpoint and Claude walks you through the sign-in.
